NEO is showing the world just how far humanoid robotics has come. From helping with everyday household chores to interacting naturally with people, this advanced robot from 1X Technologies is bringing the future of home assistance closer to reality.

MrBeast’s reaction to NEO highlights just how impressive this technology can be. Watching a humanoid robot perform everyday tasks, move around a home, and interact with people offers a fascinating glimpse into a future where robots could become helpful companions in daily life.

As artificial intelligence and robotics continue to advance, NEO represents an exciting step toward making home robots more practical, accessible, and useful. The future of technology is getting closer, and NEO is giving us a preview of what’s possible.
